committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects the Railroad Retirement Board, railroad workers eligible for benefits, retirees, rail employers, and single-employer pension plan sponsors.
dimensions.evidence: modernize the legacy benefit processing systems used by the Railroad Retirement Board

dimensions.assessment: Reorganizes administrative funding mechanisms, establishes technology modernization transfers, and adjusts pension premium payment dates for certain plan years.
dimensions.evidence: establish a Railroad Retirement Board Administrative Account, and for other purposes

dimensions.assessment: Establishes funding transfer limits based on percentages of total benefits and National Railroad Retirement Investment Trust amounts, along with specific technology fund transfers starting at $10,000,000.
dimensions.evidence: For fiscal year 2027, $10,000,000. (ii) For each of fiscal years 2028 through 2031, $20,000,000.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Railroad Retirement Act of 1974, the Railroad Unemployment Insurance Act, and alters pension premium due dates under ERISA.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Railroad Retirement Act of 1974 to establish a Railroad Retirement Board Administrative Account

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent structural account changes alongside specific multi-year funding schedules and GAO report deadlines extending through fiscal year 2031 and beyond.
dimensions.evidence: For fiscal years 2027 through 2031, the Board shall not transfer funds in a fiscal year to the Account

missing_information: Total long-term cost estimates for the complete modernization of the agency's legacy IT systems beyond the initial technology fund amounts.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill establishes a Railroad Retirement Board Administrative Account and a Technology Fund to modernize legacy benefit processing systems, alongside GAO reporting requirements and a single-employer pension premium payment acceleration.
